Grandma's Little Garden: 奶奶的小花园四季都有惊喜:每周六早上去浇水,听奶奶讲每株花的故事,学会"等待"。
My grandmother lives in a small house with a garden behind it. The garden is not big, but it is full of life. In spring, roses grow along the wall; in summer, tomatoes turn red under the hot sun.

Every Saturday morning, I ride my bike to her house and help her water the plants. She tells me stories about each flower — which one was a gift from an old friend, and which one she grew from a single seed.

Grandma often says, "A garden teaches you to wait." Now I understand her words. Plants grow slowly, but one day they surprise you with flowers or fruit. I hope I can have a little garden like hers in the future.
